buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): RITES

Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: Consignee 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA : 1. The bidder or its OEM [themselves or through reseller (S)] should have supplied th e same or similar [Similar means safety shoe/track maintainer shoe of differe nt size/rating/capacity] for 20% of the bid quantity, in at least one of the last three financial years before the bid opening date to any central /State Govt. Organisation/P SU. Copies of relevant contracts [ proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year] to be submitted along with the bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year. In case of bunch bids, the category related to the prim ary product having the highest bid value should meet this criterion. 2. Bidders must submit a valid BIS license for IS: 15298 (Pt-2) / 2016 or latest as of t he date of the tender opening, along with their bid, failing which the offer shall be su mmarily rejected. 3. Bidder must submit valid documentary proof of possessing DIP facility from FDDI, along with their bid, failing which the offer shall be summarily rejected. 4. Firms should submit a test certificate issued within the last three years for safety f ootwear to IS: 15298 (Pt-1 & 2):2016 or the latest version/IS: 15298 (Pt-2): 2016 or t he latest version from government-approved laboratories 5. ONUS OF SUBMISSION OF REQUISITE DOCUMENTS: The onus of submission of requi site documents as given above for establishing their eligibility for bulk order lies with the tenderer. Tenderers are to note that non-submission of the documents as detaile d above shall be taken as they do not have any such documents. 6. TENDER SPECIFIC AUTHORIZATION:- Authorised agents of OEM must submit Tender Specific Authorisation of the OEM. No back reference will be made in this regard & co mmunication received after opening of tender will also not be entertained. The mater ial supplied by the authorised agent will be inspected at the OEM premises by the ins pecting agency before supply. Neither one agent can represent two OEMs nor can on e OEM authorise two agents. Purchaser reserves the right to reject both bids in such cases.In a tender, either the Agent on behalf of the OEM or OEM itself can bid, but bo th cannot bid simultaneously for the same item in the same tender. In case where bo th OEM and their agent participate in bidding for same item, any or both the bids shal

l be liable to be rejected. 7. This item is reserved to be procured from Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs). Bidd ers must submit a valid Udyam Registration Certificate, along with their bid. B. OTHER CONDITIONS: 1. Part quantity inspection, supply and payment are allowed to improve upon the delivery period. 2. Sample Clause: Not applicable.RITES to inspect material strictly as per specificat ion only. 3. Security Deposit/ePBG:- As per Railway Board letter No.:-2004/ RS(G)/779/11/Pt. dt d.: 23.12.2019 will be applicable. 4. In any Terms & Condition in this BID SPECIFIC ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS ( ATC) is contradictory to the any Terms & Conditions mentioned in the GeM Bid Docu ment, the Terms & Condition in this BID SPECIFIC ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) shall prevail. (C) Description & Specification : The Railway Specification for footwear required fo r trackman is enclosed as Additional Specification Documents. Bidders are advised to carefully examine the specifications attached before quoting pric es. (D) Bidders are required to manufacture items and RITES will inspect the items as per the description & specifications enclosed in as Additional Specification Docu ments. (E) Size wise requirement : The actual size-wise requirements will be communicat ed at the time of placement of the contract/order. (F) WARANTEE CLAUSE :- Warranty will be 12 month from the date of supply. (G) INSPECTION :- 1. Inspection:- Inspection by RITES. It shall be mandatory for the RITES to get the m aterial tested at the NABL accredited lab and not in the premises of man ufacturer or suppliers. Sampling shall be done by RITES and samples sen t by RITES to NABL approved LAB. Each parameter of the specification to be tested. All test reports to be enclosed with RITES IC. All the test repor t and valid NABL lab test certificate is mandatory with the supply. 2. Cost of Inspection : All costs of inspection and test charges and other charges re lated to inspection shall be borne by the firm. 3. Place of inspection : Inspection at works of OEM only. Inspection at godown or a gents premises not permitted. No request of amendment in above terms and conditions will be entertained. 4. Offer with deviation in inspection clause will be summarily rejected without any ba ck reference.

(H) PACKING CONDITION : - The shoes should be packed in a manner that prevents damage during transportation and storage. The each piece of shoes shall b e packed in appropriate size sturdy cardboard box. Box shall have the man ufacturer name, size of shoes & PO No & date. (I) All other Terms & Conditions shall be as per GeM Terms & Conditions for purchase in Government e-Marketplace & IRS terms & Conditions of contract. Howeve r wherever there is conflict between two, GeM Terms & Conditions will prev ail. .
